title: Usage
text:
Load
module load hpc-setup       # everything
module load bioinf-tools    # bioinformatic tools
module load core-libs       # core libraries
module load terminal-utils  # terminal tools
module load samtools        # a single package
module avail                # list all modules
Legacy Nanopore tools (R9.4.1 / fast5 data) are not in the meta-modules:
module load ont-guppy nanopolish

title: hpc-setup
text:
Installs bioinformatic tools and their full software stack into one directory, without root, on Linux (Debian/Ubuntu/RHEL/Fedora, x86_64). Every package is available as an Lmod module.
mkdir ~/hpc && cd ~/hpc
wget -qO- https://github.com/nucbio/hpc-setup/raw/main/boot.sh | bash
What gets installed:

Core libraries: zlib, openssl, libcurl, cairo, glib, ImageMagick, pandoc, …
Languages: R, Python, Rust, Java, Lua
Bioinformatic tools: samtools, bowtie2, STAR, gatk, dorado, modkit, …
Terminal tools: nvim, git, bat, eza, fd, ripgrep, tree, zoxide

Full list with versions: Packages.

title: Install
text:
Needed on the system: wget, unzip, tar, gzip, xz, bzip2, gcc, g++, gfortran, make, cmake, libxml2.
Debian/Ubuntu:
sudo apt update
sudo apt install wget unzip tar gzip build-essential cmake gfortran \
  libxml2-dev libcrypt-dev libuv1-dev
Fedora:
sudo dnf install -y wget unzip tar gzip gcc gcc-c++ gcc-gfortran make cmake \
  libxml2-devel perl perl-core perl-CPAN
Optional, for R plots in X11 windows (local desktop): libx11-dev libxt-dev libxext-dev (Fedora: libX11-devel libXt-devel libXext-devel). Without them R is built without X11.

title: Install
text:
Run
Start in an empty directory (not $HOME):
mkdir ~/hpc && cd ~/hpc
wget -qO- https://github.com/nucbio/hpc-setup/raw/main/boot.sh | bash
The build takes hours. On a laptop, prevent sleep first:
systemd-inhibit --what=sleep:idle bash
The log is written to install.log. If the run stops, see Resume.

title: Resume and rebuild
text: If the installation fails, fix the cause and run the same command again in the same directory. Finished packages are skipped ([SKIP]), the failed one is built again.

text: If the installation fails, fix the cause and run the same command again in the same directory. Finished packages are skipped ([SKIP]), the failed one is built again.

title: Resume and rebuild
text:
Rebuild
wget -qO- https://github.com/nucbio/hpc-setup/raw/main/boot.sh | \
  FORCE_REBUILD="openssl zlib" bash

FORCE_REBUILD=all rebuilds everything.
Or delete the stamp: rm .stamps/openssl-*.done.
[STALE]: the install script changed since the build. Not rebuilt unless forced.

title: Resume and rebuild
text:
Update
Run the command again: packages with a new version are installed next to the old ones.
